trigger_condition: Model parameters and their gradients are located on different devices (e.g., cuda:0 and cuda:1) when clip_grad_norm_ is called.
reason: The bug is triggered by a clear device-boundary condition: clip_grad_norm_ attempts to stack gradient norms from parameters on different devices, causing a RuntimeError. This is reproducible via input/model construction and abstracts into a general pattern of device-heterogeneous parameter aggregation.
